invariant.portable_principle: A durable Go subsystem map is useful when it states active package/build facts exactly and keeps unavailable semantic facts visible.
invariant.go_mechanism: One family-local Go 1.22+ helper uses go list -e -json -mod=readonly ./... plus go/parser/go/ast.
explicit_non_goals: go/packages, go/types, gopls, third-party modules, or a shared Go platform
symbol/call identity, interface dispatch, reflection, dynamic loading, or full build-matrix analysis
responsibility clustering, lint-policy inference, refactor advice, or source mutation

tooling.selected: Family-local map_go.go using host Go and standard library only.
tooling.closure_mode: Copy only map-subsystem; no toolkit Python, repository helper, sibling skill, external Go module, or network-time dependency.
tooling.native_tool: go list -e -json -mod=readonly ./... plus go test ./... as host verification
boundaries: one root module, no active workspace, no root replace directive, one package directory
current active GOOS/GOARCH only; build variants are explicit unavailable scope
generated, test, testdata, vendor, symlink, cgo, malformed, and unresolved cases receive explicit non-clean outcomes

must_fire: first-party inbound and outbound package edges with default and alias import spelling
non_clean: unresolved first-party import or incomplete go list fact is partial
ordinary GoFiles are parsed before cgo returns partial
malformed selected source writes failed artifacts and exits nonzero
missing/old Go is a prerequisite failure without artifacts
workspace, replacement, non-root module, excluded, missing, or symlink target is unsupported

reuse_decision.shared_candidate: Go module/package discovery and source-policy helper
reuse_decision.actual_second_consumer: propose-boundary Go v1 has different caller-impact/proposal and deferral requirements.
reuse_decision.trigger_to_revisit: A later accepted consumer needs the same package discovery, source-policy, final-artifact, and copied-closure contract and measurable duplication makes a generated copied template smaller than separate implementations.

checks: copied selected-skill command writes final Markdown and JSON
